lines.translation: He is the Giver of all souls.
By Guru's Grace, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਸਭਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਣੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal sabh tripataane saadhoo charan pakhaalee jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: The beings in the water, on the land and in the sky are all satisfied; I wash the Feet of the Holy. ||3||
He is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind.
Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daan keeaa dukh bha(n)jan rate ra(n)g rasaalee jeeu ||4||32||39||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Destroyer of pain has given this Gift; I am imbued with the Love of the Delightful Lord. ||4||32||39||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan teraa dhan bhee teraa ||
lines.translation: Mind and body are Yours; all wealth is Yours.
You are my God, my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh raas tumaaree teraa jor gopaalaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Body and soul and all riches are Yours. Yours is the Power, O Lord of the World. ||1||
Forever and ever, You are the Giver of Peace.
I bow down and fall at Your Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaar kamaavaa je tudh bhaavaa jaa too(n) dehi daiaalaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: I act as it pleases You, as You cause me to act, Kind and Compassionate Dear Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh tum te lahanaa too(n) meraa gahanaa ||
lines.translation: O God, from You I receive; You are my decoration.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo too(n) dehi soee sukh sahanaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever You give me, brings me happiness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖਹਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jithai rakhahi baiku(n)th tithaaee too(n) sabhanaa ke pratipaalaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Wherever You keep me, is heaven. You are the Cherisher of all. ||3||
Meditating, meditating in remembrance, Nanak has found peace.
Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooran hoe kade na hoi dukhaalaa jeeu ||4||33||40||
lines.translation: All my hopes and desires are fulfilled; I shall never again suffer sorrow. ||4||33||40||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
The Supreme Lord God has unleashed the rain clouds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal dah dis varasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Over the sea and over the land-over all the earth's surface, in all directions, He has brought the rain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)t bhaee bujhee sabh trisanaa anad bhaiaa sabh thaaee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Peace has come, and the thirst of all has been quenched; there is joy and ecstasy everywhere. ||1||
He is the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of pain.
He gives and forgives all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪਇ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਨਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: apane keete no aap pratipaale pai pairee tisahi manaaee jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself nurtures and cherishes His Creation. I fall at His Feet and surrender to Him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee saran paiaa gat paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Seeking His Sanctuary, salvation is obtained.
With each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tis bin hor na doojaa thaakur sabh tisai keeaa jaaee jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Without Him, there is no other Lord and Master. All places belong to Him. ||3||
Yours is the Honor, God, and Yours is the Power.
You are the True Lord and Master, the Ocean of Excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kahai bena(n)tee aath pahar tudh dhiaaee jeeu ||4||34||41||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak utters this prayer: may I meditate on You twenty-four hours a day. ||4||34||41||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
All happiness comes, when God is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore ke charan man vuthe ||
lines.translation: The Feet of the Perfect Guru dwell in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗੀ ਲਿਵ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaadh lagee liv a(n)tar so ras soee jaanai jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: I am intuitively absorbed in the state of Samaadhi deep within. God alone knows this sweet pleasure. ||1||
My Lord and Master is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.
Deep within each and every heart, He dwells near and close at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa alipat jeeaa kaa daataa ko viralaa aap pachhaanai jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: He is always detached; He is the Giver of souls. How rare is that person who understands his own self. ||2||
This is the sign of union with God:
in the mind, the Command of the True Lord is recognized.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਅਨਦੁ ਖਸਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj sa(n)tokh sadaa tripataase anad khasam kai bhaanai jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Intuitive peace and poise, contentment, enduring satisfaction and bliss come through the Pleasure of the Master's Will. ||3||
God, the Great Giver, has given me His Hand.
He has erased all the sickness of birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas keee prabh apune har keeratan ra(n)g maane jeeu ||4||35||42||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those whom God has made His slaves, rejoice in the pleasure of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||35||42||
